detail.longDescription: Every Instagram post leaves a small to-do list behind it: share it on Facebook and LinkedIn, tell the team in Slack, save a copy somewhere safe, log it in a spreadsheet. Your AI assistant can help you write the caption, but those chores don't happen on their own once the chat ends. Add Zapier to your AI assistant, tell it what should happen whenever you post, and your agent sets the automation up for you. Zapier then runs it in the background, no open chat required. Rather work in Zapier itself?
